name: ContentCrew — AI Content Generation System

seo_blog.name: SEO Blog Post Generator
seo_blog.description: Generates fully optimized blog posts with keyword research, outlines, and meta data.

prompts.name: Blog Topic Research Prompt
prompts.prompt:
You are a content strategist. I need blog post ideas for {{company_name}} in the {{industry}} industry.

Analyze the following:
1. Primary keyword: {{primary_keyword}}
2. Target audience: {{target_audience}}
3. Their pain points: {{pain_points}}

Generate 10 blog post titles that:
- Target long-tail keywords related to {{primary_keyword}}
- Address specific pain points
- Have search potential (informational intent)
- Can be expanded to 1500+ words

For each title, provide:
- Working title
- Target keyword (2-4 words)
- Search intent (informational/commercial)
- Suggested word count
- 3 key points to cover

prompts.name: SEO Blog Outline Builder
prompts.prompt:
Create a detailed outline for a blog post titled "{{blog_title}}" targeting the keyword "{{target_keyword}}".

## Requirements
- Target length: {{word_count}} words
- Include an H1, 4-6 H2 sections, and relevant H3 subsections
- Naturally include {{target_keyword}} in the H1, first paragraph, and at least 3 H2 sections
- Include 2-3 LSI keywords: {{lsi_keywords}}
- Include one "Quick Tip" callout box
- End with a clear CTA

## Outline Structure
1. H1: [SEO-optimized title]
2. Introduction (2-3 paragraphs hooking the reader)
3. H2 sections with H3 subsections as needed
4. Comparison table if applicable
5. FAQ section (3-5 questions)
6. Conclusion with CTA

Provide the outline only — do NOT write the full article.

prompts.name: Full Blog Post Writer
prompts.prompt:
Write a complete blog post following this outline:
{{outline}}

## Style Guidelines
- Tone: {{tone}} (professional, conversational, technical, etc.)
- Reading level: {{reading_level}} (e.g., 8th grade for general audience)
- Use short paragraphs (2-3 sentences max)
- Include transitional phrases between sections
- Bold key terms for emphasis
- Include one {{callout_type}} callout box
- Naturally include {{target_keyword}} 4-6 times total
- Include internal links to {{internal_links}}

## SEO Requirements
- Meta title (under 60 chars): 
- Meta description (under 160 chars): 
- URL slug: 
- Featured image alt text: 

Write the full article now.

social_media.name: Social Media Content Engine
social_media.description: Generates platform-specific social media content from any input.

prompts.name: Content Pillar Generator
prompts.prompt:
I need to create a social media content pillar for {{topic}}.

Generate:

1. **One long-form post** (LinkedIn/Twitter thread):
   - Hook (1 sentence)
   - 5-7 key points with examples
   - Strong closing statement
   - 3-5 relevant hashtags

2. **Three short-form posts** (Instagram/TikTok captions):
   - Each under 150 characters
   - Each highlights a different angle
   - Include emoji and CTAs

3. **One discussion starter** (for community engagement):
   - Open-ended question
   - Poll option if applicable

4. **Visual description** for each post:
   - Image/video concept
   - Text overlay suggestion
   - Color scheme recommendation

prompts.name: Content Repurposing Engine
prompts.prompt:
Repurpose this blog post into social media content:

BLOG POST:
{{blog_content}}

Generate:

1. **LinkedIn post** (1300-1500 chars): Professional angle, key insight, mild controversy
2. **Twitter/X thread** (5-7 tweets): Tease the main points, end with link
3. **Instagram carousel** (5 slides): Title slide + 3 content slides + CTA slide
4. **Newsletter blurb** (2-3 paragraphs): Friendly, casual, with value prop
5. **Reddit post** (r/{{relevant_subreddit}}): Value-focused, no selling

For each: Write the full copy, suggest visuals, and add hashtags.

email.name: Email Newsletter Template
email.description: Generates email newsletters from curated content.

prompts.name: Newsletter Content Writer
prompts.prompt:
Write a newsletter email for {{company_name}} with the following:

## Content Items
{{content_items}}

## Structure
1. **Subject line** (5 options, under 50 chars)
2. **Preview text** (under 100 chars)
3. **Greeting**: Warm but professional
4. **Main feature**: 2-3 paragraphs on the primary content
5. **Roundup**: Bullet-point summaries of other items
6. **Personal note**: 1 paragraph from {{author_name}}
7. **CTA**: Single clear action
8. **Footer**: Unsubscribe link, social links

## Guidelines
- Write for {{audience_description}}
- Send frequency: {{frequency}}
- Brand voice: {{brand_voice}}
- Include {{affiliate_links_count}} affiliate links naturally within content

✅ Set up your content calendar (topics + dates for 30 days)
✅ Create your Custom GPT with all ContentCrew prompts
✅ Set up your social media posting schedule
✅ Test: generate 1 blog post, 3 social posts, 1 newsletter
